status: additive candidate control; no refutation record for it yet (see README.md)
statement: For an arc whose end-tangent frames are not signed permutations of the global axes, the arc end magnitudes reported in an end frame must be formed by rotating every signed contribution into that frame and then combining component by component. Combining global component magnitudes first and rotating afterwards (by the frame rows, wrong path a, or by their absolute values, wrong path b) is a different result; the witnesses below are components where it differs. Rotation commutes with linear signed summation (cluster sums, superposition, the elastic/lump split), so no linear reordering is a mutant: see linear_order_equivalence.

V-ARC-OBL.purpose: arc frame-order control: a realized arc in an oblique plane whose end-tangent frames are not signed permutations of the global axes, anchored at A and D

witness_rule.context: REQ-008 seeds the verification tolerance at 1e-9 relative; the spectrum screening class is 5e-3 on forces and moments. A witness differs by at least 1e-2 relative, on a component that is not small.

contrast_original_V_ARC_signed_permutati.max_rel_diff_b: see cross_checks (a residual of the working precision)
contrast_original_V_ARC_signed_permutati.note: wrong path b equals the correct path for a signed permutation (C1 of REFUTATION.md); wrong path a differs only by sign there
